credit.author: MediaJet

landmarks.name: Kolmanskop
landmarks.summary: 2 mi) inland from the port town of Lüderitz. It was named after a transport driver named Johnny Coleman who, during a sand storm, abandoned his ox wagon on a small incline opposite the settlement.

landmarks.name: Sveti Stefan
landmarks.summary: 7 mi) southeast of Budva. The town is known for the Aman Sveti Stefan resort, a 5-star franchise of the international group of Aman Resorts.

landmarks.name: Wat Rong Khun (White Temple)
landmarks.description: Art exhibit of a Buddhist temple in Chiang Rai, Thailand
landmarks.summary: Wat Rong Khun, better known as the White Temple, is a contemporary, privately owned art exhibit in the style of a Buddhist temple in Pa O Don Chai, Mueang District, Chiang Rai province, Thailand.

landmarks.name: Diamond Head
landmarks.description: Volcanic tuff cone on the Hawaiian island of Oʻahu
landmarks.summary: Diamond Head is a volcanic tuff cone on the Hawaiian island of Oʻahu. It is known to Hawaiians as Lēʻahi, which is most likely derived from lae plus ʻahi (tuna) because the shape of the ridgeline resembles the shape of a tuna's dorsal fin.

credit.title: File:Diamond Head Hawaii From Round Top Rd.JPG
credit.author: mar1865

landmarks.name: Yungas Road
landmarks.description: National Road in Bolivia, known for its treacherous journey
landmarks.summary: The Yungas Road, commonly referred to as Death Road, is a 64-kilometer (40 mi) long cycle and vehicle route linking La Paz, Bolivia, with the Yungas region. It was built in the 1930s by the Bolivian government. Large amounts of its construction were done by Paraguayan prisoners during the Chaco War. 8 ft) wide.

credit.title: File:Bolivia - The Worlds Most Dangerous Road.jpg
credit.author: Warren H
credit.credit: originally posted to Flickr as Bolivia - The Worlds Most Dangerous Road

landmarks.name: Mount Thor
landmarks.summary: Mount Thor, officially gazetted as Thor Peak, in Nunavut, Canada, is a mountain with an elevation of 1,675 m (5,495 ft) located in Auyuittuq National Park, on Baffin Island.

credit.title: File:Mount Thor, Akshayuk Pass, Baffin Island.jpg
credit.author: Paul Gierszewski

credit.title: File:Sunrise on Thor Peak from Mt. Whitney Trail.jpg
credit.author: David Phillips

landmarks.name: Danakil Depression
landmarks.summary: The Danakil Depression is a large valley of approximately 200 by 50 km, across the north of the Afar Region of Ethiopia and Eritrea. It is about 125 m (410 ft) below sea level and is bordered to the west by the Ethiopian Plateau and to the east by the Danakil Alps, beyond which is the Red Sea.

landmarks.name: Konye-Urgench
landmarks.summary: Konye-Urgench, also known as Köneürgenç, Old Urgench or Urganj, is a city in north Turkmenistan, just south from its border with Uzbekistan. In 2022, it had a total population of 37,176 people.

credit.title: File:Inner Dome of Turabeg Khanym Mausoluem (27574334687).jpg
credit.author: John Pavelka from Austin, TX, USA
credit.credit: Inner Dome of Turabeg Khanym Mausoluem

landmarks.name: Church of the Savior on Blood
landmarks.summary: The Church of the Savior on Spilled Blood is a Russian Orthodox church in Saint Petersburg, Russia which currently functions as a secular museum and church at the same time. The structure was constructed between 1883 and 1907. It is one of Saint Petersburg's major attractions.

credit.title: File:2019-07-30-3536-Saint-Petersburg-Church of the Saviour on the Blood interior.jpg
credit.author: Don-vip

landmarks.name: Preikestolen (Pulpit Rock)
landmarks.description: Cliff and tourist attraction in Norway
landmarks.summary: Preikestolen or Prekestolen is a tourist attraction in Strand Municipality in Rogaland county, Norway. Preikestolen is a steep cliff which rises 604 metres (1,982 ft) above Lysefjorden. Atop the cliff, there is an almost flat top of approximately 25 by 25 metres.

landmarks.name: Boudhanath Stupa
landmarks.description: Buddhist stupa in Boudha, Kathmandu, Nepal
landmarks.summary: Boudha Stupa, Boudhanath Stupa, also known as Khasti Chaitya or Khāsa Chaitya, is a stupa and major spiritual landmark seen as the embodiment of the enlightened mind of all the Buddhas.

landmarks.name: Cerro Torre
landmarks.description: Mountain in Southern Patagonia in South America
landmarks.summary: Cerro Torre is one of the mountains of the Southern Patagonian Ice Field in South America. It is located on the border dividing Argentina and Chile, west of Fitz Roy. At 3,128 m (10,262 ft), the peak is the highest of a four mountain chain: the other peaks are Torre Egger, Punta Herron, and Cerro Standhardt.

credit.title: File:Cerro Torre (east face) and Laguna Torre.JPG
credit.author: Gagea

landmarks.name: Dōtonbori
landmarks.summary: Dōtonbori or Dōtombori is a district in Osaka, Japan. Known as one of Osaka's principal tourist and nightlife areas, the area runs along the Dōtonbori canal from Dōtonboribashi Bridge to Nipponbashi Bridge in the Namba district of the city's Chūō ward.

landmarks.name: Dune of Pilat
landmarks.summary: The Dune of Pilat, also called Grande Dune du Pilat, is the tallest sand dune in Europe. 2 mi) southwest of Bordeaux along France's Atlantic coastlines.

credit.title: File:Paragliding Dune de Pilat.jpg
credit.author: Dennis Buntrock
credit.credit: https://pixabay.com/en/paragliding-mountain-paraglider-854678/ archive copy at the Wayback Machine

credit.title: File:Sommet de la Dune du Pilat.jpg
credit.author: Jörg Braukmann

landmarks.name: Ollantaytambo
landmarks.summary: Ollantaytambo is a town and an Inca archaeological site in southern Peru some 72 km (45 mi) by road northwest of the city of Cusco. It is located at an altitude of 2,792 m (9,160 ft) above sea level in the district of Ollantaytambo, province of Urubamba, Cusco region.

credit.title: File:Ollantaytambo1.jpg
credit.author: No machine-readable author provided. Xauxa assumed (based on copyright claims).
credit.credit: No machine-readable source provided. Own work assumed (based on copyright claims).

landmarks.name: Rila Monastery
landmarks.summary: The Monastery of Saint John of Rila, also known as Rila Monastery ("Sveti Ivan Rilski", is the largest and most famous Eastern Orthodox monastery in Bulgaria.

landmarks.name: Transfăgărășan
landmarks.summary: The Transfăgărășan, or DN7C, is a paved mountain road crossing the southern section of the Carpathian Mountains of Romania. It has national-road ranking and is the second-highest paved road in the country after the Transalpina.

credit.title: File:RO B Transfagarasan view towards the north from Balea Lake 2.jpg
credit.author: Andrei Stroe

landmarks.name: Vaduz Castle
landmarks.summary: Vaduz Castle is the palace and official residence of the Prince of Liechtenstein. The castle gave its name to the town of Vaduz, the capital of Liechtenstein, which it overlooks from an adjacent old hilltop.

landmarks.name: Vinicunca (Rainbow Mountain)
landmarks.summary: Vinicunca, or Winikunka, also called Montaña de Siete Colores, Montaña de Colores, or Montaña Arcoíris, is a mountain in the Andes of Peru with an altitude of 5,036 metres (16,522 ft) above sea level.

credit.title: File:Montana de colores Cusco (Vinicunca) y Valle Rojo por Inka Time.jpg
credit.author: Christian Morales Callo

landmarks.name: Arenal Volcano
landmarks.summary: Arenal Volcano is a recently active andesitic stratovolcano in north-western Costa Rica around 90 km (56 mi) northwest of San José, in the province of Alajuela, canton of San Carlos, and district of La Fortuna. The Arenal volcano stands 1,633 metres (5,358 ft) high. It is conically shaped with a crater 140 metres (460 ft) in diameter.

credit.title: File:CostaRica Arenal Volcano 1968Flow (pixinn.net).jpg
credit.author: Christophe Meneboeuf
credit.credit: Own work More photos related to Costa Rica on my website: https://www.xtof.photo

credit.author: Utcatdad

landmarks.name: Geirangerfjord
landmarks.description: Fjord in Møre og Romsdal, Norway
landmarks.summary: Geirangerfjorden (Norwegian) or Geiranger Fjord (English) is a fjord in the Sunnmøre region of Møre og Romsdal county, Norway. It is located entirely in Stranda Municipality. It is a 15-kilometre-long branch off the Sunnylvsfjorden, which itself is a branch off the Storfjorden.

credit.title: File:Seven Sisters & the Suitor falls Geiranjer fjord 10 2018 3398.jpg
credit.author: Mariordo (Mario Roberto Durán Ortiz)

landmarks.name: Pula Arena
landmarks.description: Ancient Roman amphitheater in Pula, Croatia
landmarks.summary: The Amphitheatre in Pula, better known as the Pula Arena, is a Roman amphitheatre located in Pula, Istria, Croatia.

credit.title: File:Kroatien Pula Amphitheater Innenraum 01 Blick nach Süden.jpg
credit.author: Georg Karl Ell

credit.title: File:Anfiteatro de Pula, Croacia, 2017-04-17, DD 13-18 HDR PAN.jpg
credit.author: Diego Delso

landmarks.name: Dura-Europos
landmarks.summary: Dura-Europos was a Hellenistic, Parthian, and Roman border city built on an escarpment 90 metres above the southwestern bank of the Euphrates river. It is located near the village of Salhiyé, in present-day Syria.

landmarks.name: Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut
landmarks.summary: The mortuary temple of Hatshepsut was built during the reign of Pharaoh Hatshepsut of the Eighteenth Dynasty of Egypt. Located opposite the city of Luxor, it is considered to be a masterpiece of ancient architecture. Its three massive terraces rise above the desert floor and into the cliffs of Deir el-Bahari.

credit.title: File:Temple of Hatshepsut, Statue of Horus, Luxor, Egypt.jpg
credit.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg

credit.title: File:Templo funerario de Hatshepsut, Luxor, Egipto, 2022-04-03, DD 13.jpg
credit.author: Diego Delso

landmarks.name: Palacio de Bellas Artes
landmarks.summary: The Palacio de Bellas Artes is a prominent cultural center in Mexico City. It hosts performing arts events, literature events and plastic arts galleries and exhibitions.

credit.title: File:Palacio de las Bellas Artes Vitral del Techo.jpg
credit.author: Ludan68

credit.title: File:Palacio de Bellas Artes, México D.F., México, 2013-10-13, DD 40.jpg
credit.author: Diego Delso

credit.title: File:Panel central del mural Nueva Democracia en el Palacio de Bellas Artes.jpg
credit.author: Luis Alvaz

landmarks.name: Tian Tan Buddha
landmarks.summary: The Tian Tan Big Buddha is a large bronze sculpture of Gautama Buddha, completed in 1993, and located at Ngong Ping, near Po Lin Monastery on Lantau Island, Hong Kong.

landmarks.name: Erta Ale
landmarks.description: Active basaltic shield volcano in Afar Region, Ethiopia
landmarks.summary: Erta Ale is a continuously active shield volcano in the Afar Region of northeastern Ethiopia, which is itself part of the wider Afar Triangle. The volcano is located in the Danakil Depression, an area on the border between Ethiopia and Eritrea that is below sea level.

credit.title: File:ET Afar asv2018-01 img99 way to Ertale.jpg
credit.author: A.Savin

credit.title: File:Erta Ale Crater.jpg
credit.author: Kalogeropoulos

landmarks.name: Fujian Tulou
landmarks.summary: The Fujian tulou are Chinese rural dwellings unique to the Hakka in the mountainous areas in southeastern Fujian, China. They were mostly built between the 12th and the 20th centuries.

credit.title: File:Three round, one oval, one square (16831811084).jpg
credit.author: Scott Edmunds
credit.credit: Three round, one oval, one square

landmarks.name: Island of Mozambique
landmarks.description: Historically significant island off the northeastern coast of Mozambique
landmarks.summary: The Island of Mozambique lies off northern Mozambique, between the Mozambique Channel and Mossuril Bay, and is part of Nampula Province. Prior to 1898, it was the capital of colonial Portuguese East Africa.

credit.title: File:Island of Mozambique boats.jpg
credit.author: Stig Nygaard
credit.credit: originally posted to Flickr as Island of Mozambique

landmarks.name: Mawson Peak
landmarks.summary: Mawson Peak is an active volcanic summit of the Big Ben volcanic massif on Heard Island, an Australian external territory in the Indian Ocean.

landmarks.name: Ol Doinyo Lengai
landmarks.description: Active volcano in Arusha Region, Tanzania
landmarks.summary: Ol Doinyo Lengai is an active stratovolcano in northern Tanzania. It consists of a volcanic cone with two craters, the northern of which has erupted during historical time. Uniquely for volcanoes on Earth, it has erupted natrocarbonatite, an unusually low temperature and highly fluid type of magma.

credit.title: File:Pre-eruption aerial photo of Oldoinyo Lengai.jpg
credit.author: Wcalvin
credit.credit: Taken from co-pilot seat en route Arusha from Serengeti Previously published: WilliamCalvin.org

landmarks.name: Dom Luís I Bridge
landmarks.summary: The Luiz I Bridge, commonly known as Dom Luís I Bridge, is a double-deck metal arch bridge that spans the river Douro between the cities of Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia in Portugal. At its construction, its 172 metres (564 ft) span was the longest of its type in the world.

credit.title: File:Portugal 2008 Porto Metro do Porto auf der Ponte Dom Luis I - 29767288515.jpg
credit.author: hrs51

landmarks.name: Hội An Ancient Town
landmarks.description: Historic site in Hoi An, Vietnam
landmarks.summary: Hoi An Ancient Town is a heritage site and ancient trading post located in Hoi An, which served as an important trading post for foreign traders to Vietnam from the 15th until the 19th century, the status of which is still partly maintained by the newer city today.

credit.title: File:2024-12-20 Hoi An Old Town at night 5.jpg
credit.author: Alexkom000

landmarks.name: Koutoubia Mosque
landmarks.summary: The Kutubiyya Mosque or Koutoubia Mosque is the largest mosque in Marrakesh, Morocco. It is located in the southwest medina quarter of Marrakesh, near the Jemaa el-Fnaa market place, and is flanked by large gardens.

credit.title: File:Koutoubia bab ali or first minaret remains DSCF6364.jpg
credit.author: R Prazeres

landmarks.name: Chillon Castle
landmarks.summary: Chillon Castle is a medieval island castle located on Lake Geneva, south of Veytaux in the Swiss canton of Vaud. It is situated at the eastern end of the lake, on the narrow shore between Montreux and Villeneuve, which gives access to the Alpine valley of the Rhône. Chillon is amongst the most visited medieval castles in Europe.

credit.title: File:001 Chateau de Chillon and Dents du Midi Photo by Giles Laurent.jpg
credit.author: Giles Laurent

landmarks.name: Hohensalzburg Fortress
landmarks.summary: Hohensalzburg Fortress is a large medieval fortress in the city of Salzburg, Austria. It sits atop the Festungsberg mountain at an altitude of 506 m. It was erected at the behest of the prince-archbishops of Salzburg. The fortress is 250 m (820 ft) long and 150 m (490 ft) wide making it one of the largest medieval castles in Europe.

credit.title: File:Aerial image of Hohensalzburg Fortress (view from the southwest).jpg
credit.author: Carsten Steger

landmarks.name: Angel of Independence
landmarks.description: Victory column and statue in Mexico City
landmarks.summary: The Angel of Independence, most commonly known by the shortened name El Ángel and officially known as Monumento a la Independencia, is a victory column on a roundabout on the major thoroughfare of Paseo de la Reforma in downtown Mexico City.

credit.title: File:Ángel de Independendencia, ciudad en movimiento.jpg
credit.author: Juan Francisco Contreras Fernández

landmarks.name: Blue Lagoon
landmarks.summary: The Blue Lagoon is a geothermal spa in southwestern Iceland. 1 mi) from Grindavík and in front of Mount Þorbjörn on the Reykjanes Peninsula, in a location favourable for geothermal power, and is supplied by water used in the nearby Svartsengi geothermal power station.

landmarks.name: Gullfoss
landmarks.description: Waterfall in Bláskógabyggð and Hrunamannahreppur, Iceland
landmarks.summary: Gullfoss is a waterfall located in the canyon of the Hvítá river in southwest Iceland, between the municipalities of Bláskógabyggð and Hrunamannahreppur. It is one of the most popular tourist attractions in the country, and is included in "Golden Circle" tours of the countryside near Reykjavík.

landmarks.name: Bayon
landmarks.description: Khmer temple in Angkor Thom, Cambodia
landmarks.summary: The Bayon is a richly decorated Theravada Buddhist temple of the Khmer Empire located at Angkor in Cambodia. Built in the late 12th or early 13th century as the state temple of King Jayavarman VII, it stands at the centre of Jayavarman's capital city, Angkor Thom.

landmarks.name: Lamu Old Town
landmarks.summary: Lamu or Lamu Town is a small town on Lamu Island, which in turn is a part of the Lamu Archipelago in Kenya on the continent of Africa.

credit.title: File:Lamu town on Lamu Island in Kenya.JPG
credit.author: Magnus Kjaergaard

credit.title: File:Swahili door and traditional coral walls in Lamu, Kenya.jpg
credit.author: Elena.laps

landmarks.name: Great Ocean Road
landmarks.summary: The Great Ocean Road is an Australian National Heritage-listed 240-kilometre (150 mi) stretch of road along the south-eastern coast of Australia, between the Victorian towns of Torquay and Allansford.

credit.title: File:Great Ocean Road, Lorne, Australia - Feb 2012.jpg
credit.author: Diliff

landmarks.name: Multnomah Falls
landmarks.summary: Multnomah Falls is a waterfall located on Multnomah Creek in the Columbia River Gorge, east of Troutdale, between Corbett and Dodson, Oregon, United States. The waterfall is accessible from the Historic Columbia River Highway and Interstate 84.

credit.title: File:Multnomah Falls on 2 August 2012.jpg
credit.author: John Fowler from Placitas, NM, USA

landmarks.name: Bratislava Castle
landmarks.summary: Bratislava Castle is the main castle of Bratislava, the capital of Slovakia. The massive rectangular building with four corner towers stands on an isolated rocky hill of the Little Carpathians, directly above the Danube river, in the middle of Bratislava.

credit.title: File:Bratislava Castle 2022.jpg
credit.author: Drone video
credit.credit: YouTube : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EE7X2bcYYdU – View/save archived versions on archive.org

landmarks.name: Shark Bay
landmarks.description: Bay of the Indian Ocean in Western Australia
landmarks.summary: Shark Bay is a World Heritage Site in the Gascoyne region of Western Australia. The 23,000-square-kilometre (8,900 sq mi) area is located approximately 800 kilometres (500 mi) north of Perth, on the westernmost point of the Australian continent.

credit.title: File:Stromatolites in Shark Bay.jpg
credit.author: Happy Little Nomad

credit.title: File:Shark Observatory Bay 2024-08-31.jpg

landmarks.name: Sørvágsvatn
landmarks.summary: Sørvágsvatn or Leitisvatn is the largest lake in the Faroe Islands. It is situated on the island of Vágar, between the municipalities of Sørvágur and Vágar. The local reference is mostly just Vatnið. 3 sq mi), more than three times the size of Fjallavatn, the second largest lake, also located on Vágar.

landmarks.name: Rai Stones of Yap
landmarks.summary: A rai stone, or fei stone, is one of many large artifacts that were manufactured and treasured by the native inhabitants of the Yap islands in Micronesia. They are also known as Yapese stone money or similar names.

credit.title: File:Stone money at Hibiya Park in Tokyo.JPG

landmarks.name: Chan Chan
landmarks.summary: Chan Chan, sometimes called Chimor, was the capital city of the Chimor kingdom, a pre-Columbian era culture in South America. 1 mi) west of Trujillo, Peru.

landmarks.name: Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban
landmarks.summary: The Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban is the Parliament house of Bangladesh, located at Sher-e-Bangla Nagar in Dhaka. Initially designed for the Parliament of Pakistan by architect Louis Kahn, the complex is one of the largest legislative complexes in the world, covering 840,000 m2.

credit.title: File:Panorama of National Assembly of Bangladesh (02).jpg
credit.author: Nahid Sultan

landmarks.name: Yungang Grottoes
landmarks.description: Buddhist temple grottoes in Shanxi, China
landmarks.summary: The Yungang Grottoes, formerly the Wuzhoushan Grottoes, are ancient Chinese Buddhist temple grottoes built during the Northern Wei dynasty near the city of Datong, then called Pingcheng, in the province of Shanxi.

landmarks.name: Aitutaki
landmarks.summary: Aitutaki, also traditionally known as Araʻura and Utataki, is the second most-populated island in the Cook Islands, after Rarotonga. It is an "almost atoll", with fifteen islets in a lagoon adjacent to the main island. 97 sq mi), and the lagoon has an area of between 50 and 74 km2.

credit.title: File:Reef outside Aitutaki, Cook Islands.jpg
credit.author: Mr Bullitt
credit.credit: Photo taken by Mr Bullitt from Sweden

credit.title: File:Maina Island, Aitutaki Lagoon, Cook Islands.jpg
credit.author: Patrick Nunn

landmarks.name: Ghadames
landmarks.summary: Ghadames or Ghadamis is an oasis town in the Nalut District of the Tripolitania region in northwestern Libya.

credit.title: File:Park al touta in ghadames city.jpg
credit.author: Mohamed alazrak

credit.title: File:Libya Ghadames Old Town Inside of small dwelling.JPG
credit.author: Kurt Dundy

landmarks.name: Kariba Dam
landmarks.summary: The Kariba Dam is a double curvature concrete arch dam in the Kariba Gorge of the Zambezi river basin between Zambia and Zimbabwe. The dam stands 128 metres (420 ft) tall and 579 metres (1,900 ft) long. The dam forms Lake Kariba, which extends for 280 kilometres (170 mi) and holds 185 cubic kilometres (150,000,000 acre⋅ft) of water.

credit.title: File:The way to Zambia through Kariba Dam.jpg
credit.author: Manfidza

landmarks.name: Lake Khövsgöl
landmarks.summary: Lake Khövsgöl, also referred to as Khövsgöl Sea, is a lake in Khövsgöl Province, Mongolia. It is the largest freshwater lake in the country by volume, and the second largest by area after Uvs Lake. It is nicknamed "Mother Sea" in Mongolian.

landmarks.name: San Blas Islands
landmarks.summary: The San Blas Islands of Panama is an archipelago comprising approximately 365 islands and cays, of which 49 are inhabited. They lie off the north coast of the Isthmus of Panama, east of the Panama Canal. A part of the comarca (district) Guna Yala along the Caribbean coast of Panama, it is home to the Kuna people.

credit.title: File:San Blas, Panama, Indigènes Guna dans leur canot.jpg
credit.author: Langlois, Bruno

landmarks.name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo
landmarks.summary: The Tre Cime di Lavaredo, also called the Drei Zinnen, are three distinctive battlement-like peaks, in the Sexten Dolomites of northeastern Italy. They are one of the best-known mountain groups in the Alps. The three peaks, from east to west, are:Cima Piccola / Kleine Zinne Cima Grande / Große Zinne Cima Ovest / Westliche Zinne.

credit.title: File:Monument ai Bersaglieri at Tre Cime di Lavaredo.jpg

landmarks.name: Citadelle Laferrière
landmarks.description: Historic fortress and symbol of Haitian independence
landmarks.summary: The Citadelle Laferrière, commonly known as La Citadelle, is a large early-19th-century fortress located in Milot in Nord, Haiti. 3 mi) southwest of the Three Bays Protected Area.

landmarks.name: Lake Hillier
landmarks.summary: Lake Hillier is a saline lake on the edge of Middle Island, the largest of the islands and islets that make up the Recherche Archipelago in the Goldfields-Esperance region, off the south coast of Western Australia. It is particularly notable for its pink colour. A long and thin shore divides the Southern Ocean from the lake.

landmarks.name: Heydar Aliyev Center
landmarks.summary: The Heydar Aliyev Center is a 57,500 m2 (619,000 sq ft) building complex in Baku, Azerbaijan, designed by Zaha Hadid and noted for its distinctive architecture and flowing, curved style that eschews sharp angles.

credit.title: File:“Arşın mal alan” filminin rəngli formatda premyerası.jpg
credit.author: Khalilov

landmarks.name: Tugela Falls
landmarks.summary: Tugela Falls is a complex of seasonal waterfalls located in the Drakensberg of Royal Natal National Park in KwaZulu-Natal Province, Republic of South Africa. According to some measurements, it is the world's tallest waterfall.

landmarks.name: Imam Reza Shrine
landmarks.summary: The Imam Reza shrine is the mausoleum of Ali al-Rida, the eighth Imam in Shia Islam, located in Mashhad, the province of Razavi Khorasan, Iran. As one of the holiest sites in Shia Islam, with nearly 30 million Muslims making pilgrimages to the shrine every year, it is the most visited pilgrimage site in Islam.

landmarks.name: Jaisalmer Fort
landmarks.summary: Jaisalmer Fort is situated in the city of Jaisalmer, in the Indian state of Rajasthan. It is one of the very few "living forts" in the world, as nearly one fourth of the old city's population still resides within the fort. For the better part of its 860-year history, the fort was the city of Jaisalmer.

credit.title: File:Jaisalmer fort walls and multiple defensive rings at a city gate India 28Aug2006.jpg
credit.author: Everhard van Eimeren

credit.title: File:Corridor of Jain temple - Jaisalmer Fort.jpg
credit.author: Shitha Valsan

landmarks.name: Sidi Bou Said
landmarks.description: Suburb / Commune in Carthage, Tunis Governorate, Tunisia
landmarks.summary: Sidi Bou Saïd is a town in northern Tunisia, located about 20 km northeast of the capital, Tunis.

credit.title: File:Sidi Bou Said - Cafe de delices.jpg
credit.author: Bjerkebanen

credit.title: File:Carthage Palace from Sidi Bou Said.jpg
credit.author: Fjmustak

landmarks.name: Ayutthaya
landmarks.summary: Ayutthaya Historical Park covers the ruins of the old city of Ayutthaya, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya province, Thailand. The city of Ayutthaya was founded by King Ramathibodi I in 1351,[a] though it is likely to be significantly older, based on evidence showing that the area was already populated during the Mon Dvaravati period.

credit.title: File:Wat Phra Sri Sanphet, Ayutthaya Historical Park, Thailand.jpg
credit.author: Sabyk2001 at English Wikipedia
credit.credit: own work by the original uploader

landmarks.name: Puerto Princesa Underground River
landmarks.summary: The Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park is a protected area in the Philippines.

credit.title: File:Puerto-Princesa Subterranean River National Park-112012.jpg
credit.author: Ron Van Oers

credit.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg

landmarks.name: Canals of Amsterdam
landmarks.description: 17th-century canals in the Netherlands; UNESCO World Heritage Site
landmarks.summary: Amsterdam, capital of the Netherlands, has more than 100 kilometers (62 mi) of grachten (canals), about 90 islands and 1,500 bridges. The three main canals, dug in the 17th century during the Dutch Golden Age, form concentric belts around the city, known as the Grachtengordel. Alongside the main canals are 1,550 monumental buildings.

credit.title: File:Colorful canal houses at golden hour in Damrak avenue Amsterdam the Netherlands.jpg
credit.author: Basile Morin

landmarks.name: Hanging Temple
landmarks.description: Temple built into a cliff in Shanxi province, China
landmarks.summary: The Hanging Temple, also Hengshan Hanging Temple, Hanging Monastery or Xuankong Temple is a temple built into a cliff near Mount Heng in Hunyuan County, Datong City, Shanxi Province, China. The closest city is Datong, 64 kilometres (40 mi) to the northwest.

landmarks.name: Moraine Lake
landmarks.summary: 7 mi) outside the village of Lake Louise, Alberta, Canada. It is situated in the Valley of the Ten Peaks, at an elevation of approximately 1,884 metres (6,181 ft). The lake has a surface area of 50 hectares.

credit.title: File:Moraine Lake Alberta Canada canoe docks.jpg
credit.author: WikiPedant

credit.title: File:.Moraine Lake & Mount Fay seen from Mount Temple Summit.jpg
credit.author: Khoshhat

landmarks.name: Nyhavn
landmarks.description: Street, canal and district in Copenhagen
landmarks.summary: Nyhavn is a 17th-century waterfront, canal and entertainment district in Copenhagen, Denmark. Stretching from Kongens Nytorv to the Inner Harbour just south of the Royal Playhouse, it is lined by brightly coloured 17th and early 18th century townhouses and bars, cafes and restaurants. The canal harbours many historical wooden ships.

credit.title: File:Nyhavn in August, awash with tourists.jpg
credit.author: Dicklyon

landmarks.name: Trakai Island Castle
landmarks.summary: Trakai Island Castle is an island castle located in Trakai, Lithuania, on an island in Lake Galvė. The construction of the stone castle was begun in the 14th century by Kęstutis, and around 1409 major works were completed by his son Vytautas the Great, who died in this castle in 1430.

landmarks.name: Genghis Khan Equestrian Statue
landmarks.summary: The Genghis Khan Equestrian Statue, part of the Genghis Khan Statue Complex, is a 40-metre (130 ft) tall, stainless steel statue of Genghis Khan on horseback and the world's tallest equestrian statue. 55 mi) east of the Mongolian capital Ulaanbaatar, where, according to legend, he found a golden whip.

credit.title: File:Genghis Khan Equestrian Statue, photo by Vaiz Ha.jpg
credit.author: Vaiz Ha

credit.title: File:Mongolian Goats with Genghis Khan Equestrian Statue.jpg
credit.author: Аркадий Зарубин

landmarks.name: Jemaa el-Fnaa
landmarks.summary: Jemaa el-Fnaa, also Jemaa el-Fna, Djema el-Fna or Djemaa el-Fnaa, is a square and market place in the medina quarter of Marrakesh, Morocco. It remains the main square of Marrakesh, used by locals and tourists.

credit.title: File:Marrakech Bombing Site Late in the Day.jpg
credit.author: Bjørn Christian Tørrissen

landmarks.name: Mamanuca Islands
landmarks.summary: The Mamanuca Islands of Fiji are a volcanic archipelago lying to the west of Nadi and to the south of the Yasawa Islands. The group, a popular tourist destination, consists of about 20 islands, but about seven of these are covered by the Pacific Ocean at high tide.

landmarks.name: Buzludzha Monument
landmarks.description: Abandoned communist monument house in Bulgaria
landmarks.summary: The Monument House of the Bulgarian Communist Party, also known as the Buzludzha Monument, was built on Buzludzha Peak in central Bulgaria by the Bulgarian communist government and inaugurated in 1981.

landmarks.name: Cité de Carcassonne

It is part of the Bismarck Range and the peak is the point where three provinces, Chimbu, Jiwaka and Madang, meet. landmarks.summary: The Marib Dam is a dam blocking wadi Adhanah in the Balaq Hills, located in the Ma'rib Governorate in Yemen. The current dam was built in the 1980s and is close to the ruins of the ancient dam, first built in the 8th century BC.

landmarks.description: Shield volcano in southeast Réunion, Indian Ocean
landmarks.summary: Piton de la Fournaise is a shield volcano on the eastern side of Réunion island, a French overseas department and region, in the Indian Ocean. It is currently one of the most active volcanoes in the world, along with Kīlauea in the Hawaiian Islands, Stromboli and Etna in Italy and Mount Erebus in Antarctica.

landmarks.name: Skógafoss
landmarks.summary: Skógafoss is a waterfall on the Skógá River in the south of Iceland at the cliff marking the former coastline. After the coastline had receded, the former sea cliffs remained, parallel to the coast over hundreds of kilometres, creating together with some mountains a clear border between the coastal lowlands and the Highlands of Iceland.

landmarks.name: Kerala Backwaters
landmarks.summary: The Kerala backwaters are a network of brackish lagoons and canals running parallel to the Arabian Sea along the Malabar Coast of Kerala, India. It also includes interconnected lakes, rivers, and inlets, a labyrinthine system formed by more than 900 km (560 mi) of waterways, and is sometimes compared to bayous.

landmarks.name: Paracas Candelabra
landmarks.summary: The Paracas Candelabra, also called the Candelabra of the Andes, El Candelabro, Tridente (Trident) or Tres cruces, is a well-known prehistoric geoglyph found on the northern face of the Paracas Peninsula at Pisco Bay in Peru. Pottery found nearby has been radio carbon dated to 200 BCE, the time of the Paracas culture.

landmarks.description: Pier in Santa Monica, California, United States
landmarks.summary: The Santa Monica Pier is a large pier at the foot of Colorado Avenue in Santa Monica, California, United States. landmarks.name: Kuwait Towers
landmarks.description: National building, water tank, restaurant in Kuwait City, Kuwait
landmarks.summary: The Kuwait Towers are a group of three thin towers in Kuwait City, standing on a promontory into the Persian Gulf. They were the sixth, and last, group in the larger Kuwait Water Towers system of 34 towers, and were built in a style considerably different from the other five groups.

landmarks.name: Putorana Plateau
landmarks.description: Mountainous plateau in central Siberia, Russia
landmarks.summary: The Putorana Plateau or the Putorana Mountains is a mountainous area in Russia. It is a large massif or plateau crossed by mountain ranges. The nearest large settlement is Norilsk, where foreign travel is restricted. The city is served by Alykel Airport.

landmarks.name: Tongariro National Park
landmarks.summary: Tongariro National Park, located in the central North Island, is the oldest national park in New Zealand and the sixth national park established in the world. It has been recognised by UNESCO as a World Heritage Site for its mixed cultural and natural values.

landmarks.name: Zaanse Schans
landmarks.description: Neighbourhood of Zaandam in Zaanstad, North Holland, Netherlands
landmarks.summary: Zaanse Schans is a neighbourhood of Zaandam, near Zaandijk, Netherlands. It is best known for its collection of historic windmills and wooden houses that were relocated here from the wider region north of Amsterdam for preservation.

landmarks.name: Bryggen
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Bergen, Norway
landmarks.summary: Bryggen, also known as Tyskebryggen, is a series of Hanseatic heritage commercial buildings lining up the eastern side of the Vågen harbour in the city of Bergen, Norway. Bryggen has been on the UNESCO list for World Cultural Heritage sites since 1979.

The structure was commissioned in 1389 by Timur, who ruled the area as part of the expansive Timurid Empire, to replace a smaller 12th-century mausoleum of the famous Turkic poet and Sufi mystic, Khoja Ahmed Yasawi (1093–1166).

landmarks.description: Rainforest near Río Grande, Puerto Rico
landmarks.summary: S. Forest Service since 1903. Situated immediately outside the urban core of the San Juan metro area, within 40 km (25 mi) east of the Old San Juan historic quarter, Condado and Isla Verde resort areas, Hato Rey business center, and SJU airport, the forest is mostly concentrated in the municipalities of Río Grande, Luquillo, and Naguabo.

landmarks.name: Lena Pillars
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Sakha Republic, Russia
landmarks.summary: The Lena Pillars are a natural rock formation along the banks of the Lena River in far eastern Siberia. The pillars are 150–300 metres (490–980 ft) high, and were formed in some of the Cambrian period sea-basins. The highest density of pillars is reached between the villages of Petrovskoye and Tit-Ary.

landmarks.name: Gamla Stan
landmarks.summary: Gamla Stan, until 1980 officially Staden mellan broarna, is the old town of Stockholm, Sweden. Gamla Stan consists primarily of the island Stadsholmen and includes the surrounding islets Riddarholmen, Helgeandsholmen and Strömsborg. It has a population of approximately 3,000.

landmarks.name: Santo Antão
landmarks.description: Westernmost and largest of the Barlavento islands of Cape Verde
landmarks.summary: Santo Antão is the northwesternmost island of Cape Verde. At 785 km2 (303 sq mi), it is the largest of the Barlavento Islands group, and the second largest island of Cape Verde. The nearest island is São Vicente to the southeast, separated by the sea channel Canal de São Vicente.

landmarks.name: Tiger Leaping Gorge
landmarks.summary: Tiger Leaping Gorge is a scenic canyon on the Jinsha River, a primary tributary of the upper Yangtze River. It is located 60 kilometres (37 mi) north of Lijiang City, Yunnan in southwestern China. It is part of the Three Parallel Rivers of Yunnan Protected Areas World Heritage Site.

landmarks.summary: The Cathedral of Brasília is the Roman Catholic cathedral serving Brasília, Brazil, and serves as the seat of the Archdiocese of Brasília. landmarks.summary: Horseshoe Bend is a horseshoe-shaped incised meander of the Colorado River located near the town of Page, Arizona, United States.

landmarks.name: Makgadikgadi Pan
landmarks.summary: The Makgadikgadi Pan is a salt pan situated in the middle of the dry savanna of north-eastern Botswana, is one of the largest salt flats in the world. The pan is all that remains of the formerly enormous Lake Makgadikgadi, which once covered an area larger than Switzerland, but dried up tens of thousands of years ago.

landmarks.summary: The Obelisco de Buenos Aires is a national historic monument and icon of Buenos Aires. landmarks.summary: Jökulsárlón is a large glacial lake in the southern part of Vatnajökull National Park, Iceland. landmarks.description: Movie Set / Tourist Attraction in Waikato, New Zealand

landmarks.summary: The Li River or Li Jiang is the name for the upper reaches of the Gui River in northeastern Guangxi, China. It is part of the Xijiang River system in the Pearl River basin, flowing 164 kilometres (102 mi) from Xing'an County to Pingle County.

landmarks.description: Serbian Orthodox Monastery near Deçan, Kosovo

landmarks.summary: The Russky Bridge is a cable-stayed bridge in Vladivostok, Primorsky Krai, Russia. landmarks.name: Bijagós Archipelago
landmarks.summary: The Bijagós Islands, often misspelled Bijagos in English text and formerly known in English as Bissagots, are a group of about 88 islands and islets located in the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of Guinea-Bissau.

landmarks.name: Kerma
landmarks.description: Ancient Nubian capital city in Sudan
landmarks.summary: Kerma was the capital city of the Kingdom of Kerma, which had its roots in the pre-Kerma culture in present-day Sudan from 3500 BC. Kerma is one of the largest archaeological sites in ancient Nubia.

landmarks.summary: The Belfry of Bruges is a medieval bell tower in the centre of Bruges, Belgium. One of the city's most prominent symbols, the belfry formerly housed a treasury and the municipal archives and served as an observation post for spotting fires and other dangers.

landmarks.name: Solovetsky Monastery
landmarks.description: Fortified monastery on the Solovetsky Islands, Russia
landmarks.summary: The Solovetsky Monastery is a fortified monastery located on the Solovetsky Islands in the White Sea in northern Russia. It was one of the largest Christian citadels in northern Russia before it was became a Soviet prison and labor camp from 1926 to 1939, and it served as a prototype for the camps of the Gulag system.

landmarks.name: Deadvlei
landmarks.description: Clay pan in the Namib-Naukluft Park in Namibia
landmarks.summary: Deadvlei is a white clay pan located near the more famous salt pan of Sossusvlei, in a valley between the dunes in the Namib-Naukluft Park in Namibia. Also written DeadVlei or Dead Vlei, its name means "dead marsh". Its Afrikaans name is Dooie Vlei.

landmarks.name: Ennedi Plateau
landmarks.description: Plateau located in the northeast of Chad
landmarks.summary: The Ennedi Plateau is located in the northeast of Chad, in the regions of Ennedi-Ouest and Ennedi-Est. landmarks.description: Urban area and UNESCO heritage site in Tallinn
landmarks.summary: Tallinn Old Town is the oldest part of Tallinn, Estonia. Old Town of Tallinn has managed to wholly preserve its structure of medieval and Hanseatic origin. landmarks.name: Tràng An
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Red River Delta, Vietnam
landmarks.summary: Tràng An is a scenic area located in Ninh Bình Province, near Hoa Lư, Vietnam renowned for its boat cave tours. On 23 June 2014, at the 38th session of the World Heritage Committee in Doha, the Trang An Scenic Landscape Complex was inscribed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

credit.title: File:Trang An Landscape Complex, Ninh Binh Province, Vietnam, 20240202 1447 5310.jpg
credit.author: Jakub Hałun

landmarks.name: Blyde River Canyon
landmarks.summary: The Blyde River Canyon is a 26 km long canyon located in Mpumalanga, South Africa. It is the third-largest canyon on Earth, behind the Grand Canyon and the Fish River Canyon. Unlike the Grand and Fish River Canyon, the Blyde River Canyon is a "green canyon" which is dominated by subtropical vegetation.

credit.title: File:BlydeRiverCanyonViewOfaSideofACliff.JPG
credit.author: Paul Tosio. w:en:Ptosio ( talk | contribs )
credit.credit: own work by the original uploader

credit.author: lumoplank

landmarks.name: Casco Viejo, Panama
landmarks.description: Historic District of Panama City in Panama
landmarks.summary: Casco Antiguo, also known as Casco Viejo or San Felipe, is the historic district of Panama City. Completed and settled in 1673, it was built following the near-total destruction of the original Panamá city, Panamá Viejo in 1671, when the latter was attacked by pirates.

credit.title: File:Despues del ensayo en el Teatro Nacional.jpg
credit.author: Peppopalomino

landmarks.name: Inle Lake
landmarks.summary: Inle Lake is a freshwater lake located in the Nyaungshwe Township of Shan State, part of Shan Hills in Myanmar (Burma). 9 square miles (116 km2), and one of the country's highest, at an elevation of 2,900 feet (880 m). 7 m). 5 m).

credit.title: File:Inle Lake, Fisherman in boat, Myanmar.jpg
credit.author: Vyacheslav Argenberg

landmarks.name: Wave Rock
landmarks.summary: Wave Rock is a natural rock formation that is shaped like a tall breaking ocean wave. The "wave" is about 15 m (50 ft) high and around 110 m (360 ft) long. It forms the north side of a solitary hill, which is known as "Hyden Rock".

credit.title: File:WaveRock.jpg
credit.author: Jonathan LaRocca from Houston, TX, United States

landmarks.name: Rano Raraku
landmarks.summary: Rano Raraku is a volcanic crater formed of consolidated volcanic ash, or tuff, and located on the lower slopes of Terevaka in the Rapa Nui National Park on Easter Island in Chile.

credit.title: File:Osterinsel Moais am Berghang im Landesinnern.jpg
credit.author: ProfessorX

landmarks.name: Bixby Bridge
landmarks.description: Highway bridge on the Big Sur Coast of California
landmarks.summary: Bixby Bridge, also known as Bixby Creek Bridge, on the Big Sur coast of California, is one of the most photographed bridges in California due to its aesthetic design, "graceful architecture and magnificent setting". It is a reinforced concrete open-spandrel arch bridge.

credit.title: File:Bixby Creek Bridge, California, USA - May 2013.jpg
credit.author: Diliff

landmarks.name: Gunung Mulu National Park
landmarks.summary: The Gunung Mulu National Park, also known simply as the Mulu National Park is a national park in Miri Division, Sarawak, Malaysia. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site that encompasses caves and karst formations in a mountainous equatorial rainforest setting.

landmarks.name: Mir Castle
landmarks.summary: The Mir Castle Complex is a historic fortified castle and a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Belarus. It is located in the town of Mir, in Karelichy District of Grodno Oblast, 29 kilometres (18 mi) north-west of another World Heritage site, Nesvizh Castle. Mir Castle Complex is 164 metres (538 ft) above sea level.

landmarks.name: Kirkjufell
landmarks.summary: Kirkjufell is a 463 m high hill on the north coast of Iceland's Snæfellsnes peninsula, near the town of Grundarfjörður. It is claimed to be the most photographed mountain in the country.

landmarks.name: Amman Citadel
landmarks.summary: The Amman Citadel on Citadel Hill is an archaeological site on an L-shaped hill towering over Downtown Amman, in the central part of the capital of Jordan.

credit.title: File:The Temple of Hercules, built between 162 and 166 AD when Geminius Marcianus was governor of the Province of Arabia, Amman Citadel, Jordan (38506963415).jpg
credit.author: Carole Raddato from FRANKFURT, Germany
credit.credit: The Temple of Hercules, built between 162 and 166 AD when Geminius Marcianus was governor of the Province of Arabia, Amman Citadel, Jordan

landmarks.name: Bandiagara Escarpment
landmarks.description: Escarpment in Dogon country of Mali
landmarks.summary: The Bandiagara Escarpment is a sandstone cliff in the Dogon country of Mali. It rises about 500 m (1,600 ft) above the lower sandy flats to the south, and has a length of approximately 150 km (90 mi).

credit.title: File:Bandiagara escarpment 1.jpg
credit.author: Ferdinand Reus from Arnhem, the Netherlands

landmarks.name: Kizhi Pogost
landmarks.description: Historic site in Republic of Karelia, Russia
landmarks.summary: Kizhi Pogost is a historical site dating from the 17th century on Kizhi island. The island is located on Lake Onega in the Republic of Karelia, Russia. The pogost is the area inside a fence which includes two large wooden churches and a bell-tower.

credit.author: AlixSaz

credit.author: Andrey Korchagin from St. Petersburg, Russia

landmarks.name: Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque
landmarks.summary: The Omar Ali Saifuddien Mosque. or unofficially Sultan Omar Ali Saifuddin Mosque, is a mosque in Bandar Seri Begawan, the capital of Brunei. It is one of the two state mosques, the other being Jame' Asr Hassanil Bolkiah Mosque.

landmarks.name: Uluwatu Temple
landmarks.summary: Uluwatu Temple is a Balinese Hindu temple located on the south-western tip of the Bukit Peninsula in Pecatu Village, Badung Regency, Bali, Indonesia. It is the only Balinese sea temple that is also one of the nine directional temples.

credit.title: File:004 Uluwatu Temple Close Up, Pura Uluwatu, Bali, photograph by Anandajoti Bhikkhu.jpg
credit.author: Anandajoti

landmarks.name: Vang Vieng
landmarks.summary: Vang Vieng is a city in the Vientiane Province of Laos. It is popular with tourists, specifically backpackers, seeking adventure sports as well as its karst topography. It is on the Nam Song River, 130km north of Vientiane.

credit.title: File:Karst peaks with sea of clouds at sunrise, South view from the top of Mount Nam Xay, Vang Vieng, Laos.jpg
credit.author: Basile Morin

landmarks.name: Kokoda Track
landmarks.summary: The Kokoda Track or Kokoda Trail is a single-file foot thoroughfare that runs 96 kilometres (60 mi) overland – 60 kilometres (37 mi) in a straight line – through the Owen Stanley Range in Papua New Guinea (PNG).

landmarks.name: Bukchon Hanok Village
landmarks.summary: Bukchon Hanok Village (Korean: 북촌한옥마을) is a residential neighborhood in Jongno District, Seoul, South Korea. It has many restored traditional Korean houses, called hanok. This has made it a popular tourist destination.

credit.title: File:Seoul, Jongno District, Bukchon Hanok Village, Bukchon-ro 11-gil.jpg
credit.author: Dr. Thomas Liptak

credit.title: File:Traditional hanok house with wooden doors along a steeply sloping street in Bukchon Hanok Village Seoul.jpg
credit.author: Basile Morin

landmarks.name: Mount Yasur
landmarks.summary: Mount Yasur is an active volcano on Tanna Island, Vanuatu, 361 m (1,184 ft) high above sea level, on the coast near Sulphur Bay, northeast of the taller Mount Tukosmera, which was active in the Pleistocene. It has a largely unvegetated pyroclastic cone with a nearly circular summit crater 400 m in diameter.

credit.author: Rolf Cosar

landmarks.name: Amazon Theatre, Manaus
landmarks.summary: The Amazon Theatre is an opera house located in Manaus, Brazil. It is the location of the annual Festival Amazonas de Ópera and the home of the Amazonas Philharmonic Orchestra which regularly rehearses and performs at the Amazon Theatre along with choirs, musical concerts and other performances.

credit.title: File:Teatro Amazonas interior do nave - panoramio (2).jpg
credit.author: James Martins

landmarks.name: Blue Mountains, Jamaica
landmarks.summary: The Blue Mountains are the longest mountain range in Jamaica. They include the island's highest point, Blue Mountain Peak, at 2,256 m (7,402 ft). From the summit, accessible via a walking track, both the north and south coasts of the island can be seen.

credit.title: File:Fog hangs over the village of Section in the Blue Mountains of Portland Parish, Jamaica.jpg
credit.author: Matthew.kowal

landmarks.name: Peyto Lake
landmarks.summary: Peyto Lake is a glacier-fed lake in Banff National Park in the Canadian Rockies. It is known for its striking turquoise colour making it a well visited and photographed area of the National Park. The lake is near the Icefields Parkway in Alberta, Canada.

credit.title: File:Peyto Lake Panorama – taken from look out on walking trail.jpg
credit.author: KaleighAlysse

landmarks.name: Volcanoes National Park
landmarks.summary: Volcanoes National Park is a national park in northwestern Rwanda. It covers 160 km2 (62 sq mi) of rainforest and encompasses five of the eight volcanoes in the Virunga Mountains, namely Karisimbi, Bisoke, Muhabura, Gahinga and Sabyinyo.

credit.title: File:Mountain gorilla from Susa Group in Karisimbi thicket of Volcanoes National Park in Rwanda. Emmanuel Kwizera.jpg

credit.author: Trougnouf (Benoit Brummer)

landmarks.name: Makhtesh Ramon
landmarks.description: Erosion cirque in the Negev Desert, Israel
landmarks.summary: Makhtesh Ramon is a geological feature of Israel's Negev desert. Located some 85 km south of Beersheba, the landform is the world's largest "erosion cirque". The formation is 40 km long, 2–10 km wide and 500 meters deep. Despite its appearance, it is not an impact crater from a meteor nor a volcanic crater formed by a volcanic eruption.

landmarks.name: Tsingy de Bemaraha
landmarks.summary: The Tsingy de Bemaraha National Park is a national park located in northwest Madagascar. It is mainly within the boundaries of Antsalova District, with a small part in the northeast falling within Morafenobe District. The national park centers on two geological formations: the Great Tsingy and the Little Tsingy.

landmarks.name: Boulders Beach
landmarks.description: Beach in Cape Town, South Africa
landmarks.summary: Boulders Beach is a sheltered beach made up of inlets between granite boulders, from which the name originated. It is located on the eastern side of the Cape Peninsula, in Simon's Town, in the southern region of Cape Town, South Africa. It is also commonly known as Boulders Bay.

credit.title: File:Playa de Boulders, Simon's Town, Sudáfrica, 2018-07-23, DD 47.jpg
credit.author: Diego Delso

landmarks.name: Pico Cão Grande
landmarks.description: Geographic landmark in São Tomé and Príncipe
landmarks.summary: The Pico Cão Grande is a landmark needle-shaped volcanic plug peak in São Tomé and Príncipe, in the Caué District of São Tomé Island in Parque Natural Obô de São Tomé. Its summit is 663 m (2,175 ft) above sea level, and it rises about 370 m (1,210 ft) over the surrounding terrain.

credit.title: File:Cão Grande et Cão Pequeno à São Tomé (3).jpg
credit.author: Ji-Elle

landmarks.name: Avenue of the Baobabs
landmarks.summary: 8 between Morondava and Belon'i Tsiribihina in the Menabe region of western Madagascar. Its striking landscape draws travelers from around the world, making it one of the most visited locations in the region.

credit.author: Pat Hooper from Chicago, IL, USA

credit.title: File:Walking the Avenue of the Baobabs.jpg

landmarks.name: El Capitolio
landmarks.description: Former seat of the Congress of Cuba
landmarks.summary: The National Capitol of Cuba, also known as Capitolio Nacional de La Habana , and often simply referred to as El Capitolio (The Capitol), is a public edifice in Havana, the capital of Cuba. The building was commissioned by Cuban president Gerardo Machado and built from 1926 to 1929 under the direction of Eugenio Rayneri Piedra.

landmarks.name: Hvalsey Church
landmarks.description: Preserved Norse church ruins in Greenland
landmarks.summary: Hvalsey Church was a Catholic church at the abandoned Greenlandic Norse homestead of Hvalseyjarfjord. The best preserved Norse ruins in Greenland, the church was also the location of the last written record of the Greenlandic Norse, a wedding in September 1408.

landmarks.name: Kek Lok Si
landmarks.description: Buddhist temple in George Town, Penang, Malaysia
landmarks.summary: The Kek Lok Si Temple is a Buddhist temple in George Town in the Malaysian state of Penang. Located at Ayer Itam, it is the largest Buddhist temple in Malaysia and an important pilgrimage centre for Buddhists from Hong Kong, the Philippines, Singapore and other parts of Southeast Asia.

credit.title: File:Kek Lok Si during Chinese New Year 2025.jpg
credit.author: HundenvonPenang

landmarks.name: Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá
landmarks.description: Underground Roman Catholic church in Colombia
landmarks.summary: The Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá is an underground Roman Catholic church built within the tunnels of a salt mine 200 metres (660 ft) underground in a halite mountain near the city of Zipaquirá, in Cundinamarca, Colombia. It is a tourist destination and place of pilgrimage in the country.

landmarks.name: Golden Rock (Kyaiktiyo Pagoda)
landmarks.description: Prominent Buddhist pilgrimage site in Myanmar
landmarks.summary: Kyaiktiyo Pagoda is a well-known Buddhist pilgrimage site in Mon State, Myanmar. It is a small pagoda built on the top of a granite boulder covered with gold leaves pasted on by its male worshippers.

landmarks.name: Old Man of Storr
landmarks.description: Rocky hill on the Isle of Skye, Scotland
landmarks.summary: The Storr is a mountain on the Trotternish peninsula of the Isle of Skye in Scotland. The hill presents a steep rocky eastern face overlooking the Sound of Raasay, contrasting with gentler grassy slopes to the west.

credit.title: File:Old Man of Storr, Isle of Skye, Scotland - Diliff.jpg
credit.author: Diliff

landmarks.name: Monserrate
landmarks.summary: Monserrate is a mountain over 3,000 metres high that overlooks the city center of Bogotá, the capital city of Colombia. It rises to 3,152 meters (10,341 ft) above the sea level, where there is a church with a shrine, devoted to El Señor Caído.

landmarks.name: Pura Ulun Danu Bratan
landmarks.summary: Pura Ulun Danu Beratan, or Pura Bratan, is a major Hindu Shaivite temple in Bali, Indonesia. The temple complex is on the shores of Lake Beratan in the mountains near Bedugul.

landmarks.summary: The Tsodilo Hills are a UNESCO World Heritage Site (WHS), consisting of rock art, rock shelters, depressions, and caves in Botswana, Southern Africa.

landmarks.name: Valdes Peninsula
landmarks.summary: The Valdés Peninsula is a peninsula into the Atlantic Ocean in the Viedma Department of northeast Chubut Province, Argentina. It is bordered by San Matías Gulf to the north. It is an important nature reserve which was listed as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 1999.

landmarks.name: Grand-Bassam
landmarks.summary: Grand-Bassam is a town in southeastern Ivory Coast, lying east of Abidjan. It is a sub-prefecture of and the seat of Grand-Bassam Department; it is also a commune. During the late 19th century, Grand-Bassam was briefly the French colonial capital of Ivory Coast.

credit.author: Wilaxe

landmarks.name: Kjeragbolten
landmarks.summary: Kjeragbolten is a boulder on the mountain Kjerag in the eastern part of Sandnes Municipality in Rogaland county, Norway. The rock itself is a 5-cubic-metre (180 cu ft) glacial deposit wedged in a large crevice in the mountain. It is a popular tourist destination and is accessible without any climbing equipment.

landmarks.name: Charyn Canyon
landmarks.summary: Charyn Canyon, also known as the Sharyn Canyon is a canyon on the Charyn River in Kazakhstan. It is located about 200 km (120 mi) east of Almaty, close to the Kazakh–Chinese border. The canyon is roughly 154 km (96 mi) in length.

landmarks.name: Disko Bay
landmarks.description: Bay on the western coast of Greenland
landmarks.summary: Disko Bay is a large bay on the western coast of Greenland. The bay constitutes a wide southeastern inlet of Baffin Bay.

landmarks.name: Moeraki Boulders
landmarks.description: Large spherical boulders on Otago coast, New Zealand
landmarks.summary: The Moeraki Boulders are unusually large spherical boulders lying along a stretch of Koekohe Beach on the wave-cut Otago coast of New Zealand between Moeraki and Hampden. They occur scattered either as isolated or clusters of boulders within a stretch of beach where they have been protected in a scientific reserve.

landmarks.name: Bahrain World Trade Center
landmarks.description: Twin skyscraper complex in Manama, Bahrain
landmarks.summary: The Bahrain World Trade Center is a 240-metre-high (787 ft), 50-floor, twin tower complex located in Manama, Bahrain. Designed by the multi-national architectural firm Atkins, construction on the towers was completed in 2008. It is the first skyscraper in the world to integrate wind turbines into its design.

landmarks.name: Burana Tower
landmarks.description: Large minaret in the Chüy Valley in northern Kyrgyzstan
landmarks.summary: The Burana Tower is a large minaret in the Chüy Valley in northern Kyrgyzstan. It is located about 80 km east of the country's capital Bishkek, near the town of Tokmok.

landmarks.name: Ilulissat Icefjord
landmarks.description: Fjord in Greenland, Kingdom of Denmark
landmarks.summary: Ilulissat Icefjord is a fjord in western Greenland. Located 250 km north of the Arctic Circle, the Ilulissat Icefjord runs west 40 km (25 mi) from the Greenland ice sheet to Disko Bay just south of the town of Ilulissat.

landmarks.name: Manpupuner Rock Formations
landmarks.summary: The Manpupuner rock formations are a set of 7 stone pillars located west of the Ural Mountains in the Troitsko-Pechorsky District of the Komi Republic. They are located on the territory of the Pechoro-Ilychski Reserve on the mountain Man-Pupu-nyor, between the Ilych and Pechora rivers.

landmarks.description: Westernmost volcano in the Ecuadorian Andes
landmarks.summary: Quilotoa is a water-filled crater lake and the most western volcano in the Ecuadorian Andes.

landmarks.name: Casa Milà
landmarks.summary: Casa Milà, popularly known as La Pedrera in reference to its unconventional rough-hewn appearance, is a Modernista building in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain. It was the last private residence designed by architect Antoni Gaudí and was built between 1906 and 1912.

landmarks.name: Nā Pali Coast
landmarks.description: State park in Hawaii, United States
landmarks.summary: S. state of Hawaii, located in the center of the rugged 16-mile (26 km) northwest side of Kauaʻi, the second-oldest inhabited Hawaiian island. The Nā Pali coast itself extends southwest from Keʻe Beach all the way to Polihale State Park. The nā pali along the shoreline rise as much as 4,000 feet (1,200 m) above the Pacific Ocean.

landmarks.name: Jeita Grotto
landmarks.summary: 6 mi). The caves are situated in the Nahr al-Kalb river valley within the locality of Jeita, 18 kilometres (11 mi) north of the Lebanese capital Beirut.

landmarks.name: Tjibaou Cultural Centre
landmarks.summary: 0 mi) northeast of the historic centre of Nouméa, the capital of New Caledonia, celebrates the vernacular Kanak culture, the indigenous culture of New Caledonia, amidst much political controversy over the independent status sought by some Kanaks from French rule.

landmarks.summary: 2 mi) north of Paphos harbour in Cyprus. In 1980, it was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site along with Nea Paphos in modern Paphos and Palaepahos in modern Kouklia.

landmarks.name: Waitomo Caves
landmarks.summary: The Waitomo Glowworm Cave is a cave with several large chambers at Waitomo in the North Island of New Zealand. The cave is a tourist attraction known for its population of Arachnocampa luminosa, a glowworm species found only in New Zealand.

landmarks.name: Baščaršija
landmarks.summary: Baščaršija is Sarajevo's old bazaar and the historical and cultural center of the city. It is also a local community within the Stari Grad municipality. Baščaršija was built in the 15th century when Isa-beg Ishaković founded the city.

landmarks.name: Erg Chebbi
landmarks.description: Broad, flat area of desert in Morocco
landmarks.summary: Erg Chebbi is one of Morocco's several ergs – large seas of dunes formed by wind-blown sand. It is located on the far western edge of the Sahara Desert. Other ergs in Morocco include Erg Chigaga near M'hamid.

landmarks.name: Kamianets-Podilskyi Castle
landmarks.description: Castle and fortress in Kamianets-Podilskyi, Ukraine
landmarks.summary: The Kamianets-Podilskyi Castle is a former Ruthenian-Lithuanian castle and a later three-part Polish fortress located in the historic city of Kamianets-Podilskyi, Ukraine, in the historic region of Podilia in the western part of the country. Its name is attributed to the root word 'kamin', from the Slavic word for 'stone'.

landmarks.name: Nine Arches Bridge
landmarks.description: Colonial railway bridge in Sri Lanka
landmarks.summary: The Nine Arch Bridge also called the Bridge in the Sky, is a viaduct bridge in Sri Lanka and one of the best examples of colonial-era railway construction in the country.

landmarks.name: Osun-Osogbo
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Osogbo, Nigeria
landmarks.summary: Osun-Osogbo is a sacred grove along the banks of the Osun river just outside the city of Osogbo, Osun State of Nigeria.

credit.title: File:Osun Sacred Grove forest Osogbo Main Gate.jpg
credit.author: Vitus Emmanuel Nnaemeka

landmarks.name: Po-i-Kalyan, Bukhara
landmarks.description: Islamic religious complex in Bukhara, Uzbekistan
landmarks.summary: Po-i-Kalan, or Poi Kalan, is an Islamic religious complex located in Bukhara, Uzbekistan. The complex consists of three parts, the Kalan Mosque, the Kalan Minaret to which the name refers, and the Mir-i-Arab Madrasah.

landmarks.name: Osorno Volcano
landmarks.summary: Osorno Volcano is a 2,652-metre-tall (8,701 ft) conical stratovolcano lying between Osorno Province and Llanquihue Province in the Los Lagos Region of southern Chile. It stands on the southeastern shore of Llanquihue Lake, and also towers over Todos los Santos Lake.

landmarks.name: Quebrada de Humahuaca
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Jujuy Province, Argentina
landmarks.summary: The Quebrada de Humahuaca is a narrow mountain valley located in the province of Jujuy in northwest Argentina, 1,649 km (1,025 mi) north of Buenos Aires. It is about 155 km (96 mi) long, oriented north–south, bordered by the Altiplano in the west and north, by the Sub-Andean hills in the east, and by the warm valleys in the south.

credit.title: File:Serranía de Hornocal up close near Humahuaca.jpg
credit.author: Havardtl

landmarks.name: Piton des Neiges
landmarks.description: Shield volcano in northwest Réunion, Indian Ocean
landmarks.summary: The Piton des Neiges is a 3,069 m (10,069 ft) complex volcano on Réunion, one of the French volcanic islands in the Mascarene Archipelago in the southwestern Indian Ocean. It is located about 800 kilometres (500 mi) east of Madagascar.

landmarks.name: Bungle Bungle Range
landmarks.summary: The Purnululu National Park is a World Heritage Site in the East Kimberley region of Western Australia. The 239,723-hectare (592,370-acre) national park is located approximately 300 kilometres (190 mi) south of Kununurra, with Halls Creek located to the south. [is a] remote area managed as wilderness.

landmarks.name: Cradle Mountain
landmarks.summary: Cradle Mountain is a locality and mountain in the Central Highlands region of the Australian state of Tasmania. The mountain is situated in the Cradle Mountain-Lake St Clair National Park.

credit.author: Bjørn Christian Tørrissen

landmarks.name: Phang Nga Bay
landmarks.summary: Phang Nga Bay is a 400 km2 (150 sq mi) bay in the Andaman Sea between the island of Phuket and the mainland of the Kra Isthmus of southern Thailand. Since 1981, an extensive section of the bay has been protected as the Ao Phang Nga National Park. The park is in Phang Nga Province, at 8°17′N 98°36′E.

landmarks.name: Lake Teletskoye
landmarks.summary: Lake Teletskoye is the largest lake in the Altai Mountains and the Altai Republic, Russia, and has depth up to 325 meters.

credit.title: File:Teletskoye lake. Dawn in the village of Artybash at the source of the Biya.jpg
credit.author: Александр Байдуков

landmarks.name: Railay Beach
landmarks.summary: Railay, also known as Rai Leh, is a small peninsula between the city of Krabi and Ao Nang in Thailand. It is accessible only by boat due to high limestone cliffs cutting off mainland access. These cliffs attract rock climbers from all over the world, but the area is also popular due to its beautiful beaches and quiet relaxing atmosphere.

landmarks.name: Royal Naval Dockyard, Bermuda
landmarks.description: Base of the Royal Navy in the Western Atlantic
landmarks.summary: HMD Bermuda was the principal base of the Royal Navy in the Western Atlantic between American independence and the Cold War. The Imperial fortress colony of Bermuda had occupied a useful position astride the homeward leg taken by many European vessels from the New World since before its settlement by England in 1609.

credit.author: Captain-tucker

landmarks.name: Shah Cheragh
landmarks.description: Funerary monument and mosque in Shiraz, Iran
landmarks.summary: The Shah Cheragh is a Twelver Shia funerary monument and religious complex located in Shiraz, in the province of Fars, Iran. The 12th-century complex is centred around the mausoleums of Ahmad ibn Musa and Mir Muhammad ibn Mussa, two sons of the seventh Shia Imam Musa al-Kazim.

credit.author: Diego Delso

landmarks.name: Ganvié
landmarks.summary: Ganvie is a lake village in Benin, Africa, lying in Lake Nokoué, near Cotonou. With a population of around 20,000 people, it is probably the largest lake village in Africa and is very popular with tourists.

landmarks.name: Mrauk U
landmarks.summary: Mrauk U is a town in northern Rakhine State, Myanmar. It is the capital of Mrauk-U Township, a subregion of the Mrauk-U District.

landmarks.name: Whitehaven Beach
landmarks.summary: Whitehaven Beach is on Whitsunday Island, Queensland, Australia. The island is accessible by boat, seaplane, or helicopter from Airlie Beach, as well as from Hamilton Island. It lies across from Stockyard Beach, also known as Chalkie's Beach, on Haslewood Island.

landmarks.name: Fish River Canyon
landmarks.summary: The Fish River Canyon is located in the south of Namibia. It is the largest canyon in Africa, and the second most visited tourist attraction in Namibia. It features a gigantic ravine, in total about 160 kilometres (100 mi) long, up to 27 km wide and in places almost 550 meters deep.

landmarks.name: Honghe Hani Rice Terraces
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Yunnan, China
landmarks.summary: The Honghe Hani Rice Terraces are the system of Hani rice-growing terraces located in Yuanyang County, Honghe Prefecture, Yunnan, China. The terraces' history spans around 1,200 years.

credit.title: File:1 yuanyang county rice terrace bada view 2012.jpg
credit.author: chensiyuan

landmarks.name: Marble Caves
landmarks.summary: General Carrera Lake or Lake Buenos Aires is a deep lake located in Patagonia and shared by Argentina and Chile. Both names are internationally accepted, while the autochthonous name of the lake is Chelenko, which means "stormy waters" in Aonikenk.

landmarks.name: Si-o-se-pol
landmarks.description: Double-level arch bridge located in Isfahan, Iran
landmarks.summary: The Allahverdi Khan Bridge, popularly known as Si-o-se-pol, is the largest of the eleven historical bridges on the Zayanderud, the largest river of the Iranian Plateau, in Isfahan, Iran.

landmarks.name: Aso Rock
landmarks.summary: Aso Rock is a large outcrop of granitic rock located on the outskirts of Abuja, the capital of Nigeria. The Aso Rock is a monolith with a peak height of 936 metres (3,071 ft) above sea level, 400 metres (1,300 ft) above the surrounding land. It is one of the city's most noticeable features.

credit.author: Mark Fischer

landmarks.name: Laas Geel
landmarks.summary: Laas Geel, also spelled Laas Gaal, are cave formations on the rural outskirts of Hargeisa, Somaliland, situated in the Maroodi Jeex region of the country. They contain some of the earliest known cave paintings of domesticated African aurochs in the Horn of Africa.

credit.title: File:ASC Leiden - van de Bruinhorst Collection - Somaliland 2019 - 4574 - Visitors of the Hargeysa 12th International Book Fair 20-25 July 2019 in the caves with rock paintings of Laas Geel.jpg
credit.author: Gerard van de Bruinhorst

credit.title: File:Laas Geel Cave with Rock Art, September 2022.jpg
credit.author: Tinasimonrowe

landmarks.name: Vianden Castle
landmarks.summary: Vianden Castle, located in Vianden in the north of Luxembourg, is one of the largest fortified castles west of the Rhine. With origins dating from the fourth century as a Roman outpost and the 10th century, the more familiar castle form was built in the Romanesque style from the 11th to 14th centuries.

landmarks.name: Isla del Sol
landmarks.description: Island in the southern part of Lake Titicaca
landmarks.summary: Isla del Sol is an island in the southern part of Lake Titicaca. It is part of Bolivia, and specifically part of the La Paz Department. Geographically, the terrain is harsh; it is a rocky, hilly island with many eucalyptus trees. There are no motor vehicles or paved roads on the island.

landmarks.name: Mana Pools National Park
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Zimbabwe
landmarks.summary: Mana Pools National Park is a 2,196-square-kilometre (848 sq mi) wildlife conservation area and national park in northern Zimbabwe. It is a region of the lower Zambezi in Zimbabwe where the floodplain turns into a broad expanse of lakes after each rainy season.

credit.author: Babakathy

credit.title: File:Island in the Zambezi River at Mana Pools National Park.jpg
credit.author: Babakathy

landmarks.name: Nelson's Dockyard
landmarks.description: Cultural heritage site and marina on Antigua in Antigua and Barbuda
landmarks.summary: Nelson's Dockyard is a cultural heritage site and marina in English Harbour, located in Saint Paul on the Caribbean island of Antigua, in Antigua and Barbuda. It is the only continuously working Georgian era dockyard in the world. It was built in the early 18th century and abandoned by the British Royal Navy in 1889.

credit.title: File:View from Fort Hill Dow - Deep Bay - Nelson's Dockyard - panoramio.jpg
credit.author: Edgar El

landmarks.name: Old City of Sanaa
landmarks.description: District in Amanat Al Asimah, Yemen
landmarks.summary: The Old City of Sanaʽa is a recognised UNESCO World Heritage Site in the Amanat Al Asimah Governorate, Yemen. As of 2003, the district had a population of 63,398 inhabitants. The old fortified city has been inhabited for more than 2,500 years and contains many intact architectural sites.

landmarks.name: Viñales Valley
landmarks.summary: Viñales Valley is a karstic depression in Cuba. The valley has an area of 132 km2 (51 sq mi) and is located in the Sierra de los Órganos mountains, just north of Viñales in the Pinar del Río Province.

landmarks.name: Pico do Arieiro
landmarks.summary: Pico do Areeiro, at 1,818 m (5,965 ft) high is a mountain located on the Portuguese island and autonomous region of Madeira, the third highest on the island. Situated within the mountainous interior of the island roughly halfway between the northern and southern coasts.

landmarks.name: Chapada dos Veadeiros National Park
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goiás, Brazil
landmarks.summary: 8 billion years. The park was created on January 11, 1961, by President Juscelino Kubitschek, and listed as a World Heritage Site by Unesco in 2001. It occupies an area of 2,405 square kilometres (929 mi2) in the municipalities of Alto Paraíso de Goiás, Cavalcante and Colinas do Sul.

landmarks.name: Koutammakou
landmarks.summary: Koutammakou, the Land of the Batammariba is a cultural landscape designated in 2004 and expanded in 2023 as a UNESCO World Heritage Site at the border between northern Togo and Benin. The area features traditional mud tower-houses which remain the preferred style of living.

landmarks.name: Lake Abbe
landmarks.description: Lake on the border of Djibouti and Ethiopia
landmarks.summary: Lake Abbe, also known as Lake Abhe Bad, is a salt lake, lying on the Ethiopia-Djibouti border. It is one of a chain of six connected lakes, which also includes lakes Gargori, Laitali, Gummare, Bario and Afambo. The lake is the ultimate destination of the Awash River, which is at the center of the Afar Triangle.

credit.title: File:Lac sidi mohamed ben ali sidi bel abbes.jpg
credit.author: Shatatady

landmarks.name: Rock Islands
landmarks.description: Collection of reef islands in Palau
landmarks.summary: The Rock Islands of Palau, also called Chelbacheb, are a collection of several hundred small limestone or coral uprises in the Southern Lagoon of Palau between Koror and Peleliu, now an incorporated part of Koror State.

landmarks.name: Fes el Bali
landmarks.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site in Fez, Morocco
landmarks.summary: Fes el Bali is the oldest part of Fez, Morocco. It is one of the three main districts of Fez, along with Fes Jdid and the French-created Ville Nouvelle.

landmarks.name: Hierve el Agua
landmarks.description: Waterfall in Mexican state of Oaxaca
landmarks.summary: Hierve el Agua is a set of natural travertine rock formations in San Lorenzo Albarradas, Oaxaca, Mexico that resemble cascades of water.

credit.title: File:Formaciones rocosas de Hierve el Agua, Oaxaca, México..JPG
credit.author: Laloixx

landmarks.name: Santa Ana Volcano
landmarks.summary: The Santa Ana Volcano or Ilamatepec is a large stratovolcano located in the Santa Ana department of El Salvador. At 2,381 metres (7,812 ft) above sea level, it is the highest volcano in the country. It is located immediately west of Coatepeque Caldera.

credit.author: Erneestoo

credit.title: File:Cratère du Volcan de Santa Ana, Salvador.jpg
credit.author: Emberlifi

landmarks.name: Bhaktapur Durbar Square
landmarks.summary: Bhaktapur Durbar Square is a former royal palace complex located in Bhaktapur, Nepal. It housed the Malla kings of Nepal from 14th to 15th century and the kings of the Kingdom of Bhaktapur from 15th to late 18th century until the kingdom was conquered in 1769.

credit.title: File:Krishna Temple Bhaktapur durbar Square Bhaktapur Nepal Rajesh Dhungana.jpg
credit.author: Rajesh Dhungana

landmarks.name: Castillo San Felipe de Barajas
landmarks.summary: The Castillo San Felipe de Barajas is a fortress in the city of Cartagena, Colombia. Constructed in 1639, it is located on Cerro San Lázaro in a location that overlooks approaches to the city by land or sea. It was originally known as the Castillo de San Lázaro.

credit.author: Ivonne Correa

credit.title: File:Fuerte de San Lázaro en la cima del Castillo de San Felipe de Baraja. Cartagena.JPG
credit.author: Kamilokardona

landmarks.name: Selarón Steps
landmarks.description: Set of steps in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
landmarks.summary: Escadaria Selarón, locally known as the 'Lapa Steps' for being situated at the "Lapa" neighborhood, is a set of world-famous steps in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. They are the work of Chilean-born artist Jorge Selarón who claimed it as "my tribute to the Brazilian people".

credit.title: File:Selaron Stairs, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil.jpg
credit.author: Marshallhenrie

landmarks.name: Kuang Si Falls
landmarks.summary: The Kuang Si Falls or Kuang Xi Falls, alternatively known as the Tat Kuang Si Waterfalls, is a multi-tiered waterfall in Laos about 29 kilometers (18 mi) south of the town of Luang Prabang. The journey takes 53 minutes from Luang Prabang Night Market downtown.

credit.title: File:The river of Kuang si waterfalls.jpg
credit.author: NruasPaoYPP

credit.title: File:Kuang Si Falls and a turquoise water pool in Luang Prabang province Laos.jpg
credit.author: Basile Morin

landmarks.name: Chouara Tannery, Fez
landmarks.summary: Chouara Tannery is one of the three tanneries in the city of Fez, Morocco. It is the largest tannery in the city and one of the oldest. It is located in Fes el Bali, the oldest medina quarter of the city, near the Saffarin Madrasa along the Oued Fes.

credit.title: File:Men dyeing leather in the the old town of Fès, Morocco.jpg
credit.author: Ralf Steinberger

landmarks.name: Punakha Dzong
landmarks.summary: The Punakha Dzong, also known as Pungthang Dewa Chhenbi Phodrang, is the administrative centre of Punakha District in Punakha, Bhutan. Constructed by Ngawang Namgyal, 1st Zhabdrung Rinpoche, in 1637–38, it is the second oldest and second-largest dzong in Bhutan and one of its most majestic structures.

credit.title: File:Bhutan - Punakha Dzong - Monks living quarters - panoramio (1).jpg
credit.author: David Broad

landmarks.name: Kakum National Park
landmarks.summary: Kakum National Park, located in the coastal environs of the Central Region of Ghana, covers an area of 375 square kilometres (145 sq mi). Established in 1931 as a reserve, it was gazetted as a national park only in 1992 after an initial survey of avifauna was conducted. The area is covered with tropical forest.
